einzeiler: A detailed discussion of the 1992 thriller Unlawful Entry starring Kurt Russell.
kurzfassung: The hosts review the 1992 non-erotic thriller Unlawful Entry, directed by Jonathan Kaplan and starring Kurt Russell, Ray Liotta, and Madeline Stowe. They analyze the psychological tension, the dynamics between the main characters, and the similarities to other classic thrillers. The episode also features casual banter about comic book projects, video game soundtracks, and personal updates.
stichpunkte: Discussion of the 1992 thriller Unlawful Entry directed by Jonathan Kaplan
Analysis of Ray Liotta's performance as the unhinged police officer
Comparison of the film's tone and structure to other thrillers like The Invisible Man and Lakeview Terrace
Examination of the relationship dynamics and tension between Kurt Russell and Madeline Stowe's characters
Review of the 4K release and availability of the movie on streaming platforms
Banter about video game music from Doom and the Legacy of Rust expansion
Self-promotion of the comic book Garden City Volume 2

The panel pokes fun at a bizarrely tense domestic interaction in the movie involving an unwanted home massage.

beschreibung: "What are you gonna do, tough guy? You gonna make a citizen's arrest?" This week on Film Junk, we are ending the summer season off with a fun '90s thriller starring Kurt Russell, Ray Liotta and Madeleine Stowe. Unlawful Entry is not necessarily a masterpiece but it is watchable in the best way possible. Does this movie have a deeper social commentary or is it just a shallow genre exercise? Is Ray Liotta's performance deserving of more praise than an MTV Movie Award nomination? What would you do if you got the chance to beat up the man who broke into your house and terrorized your wife? Try and guess our seven-letter password on this week's episode of Film Junk.
